title: Checkout-Api incident after SEV-1 deployment
description: The checkout-api began to show p95 latency increased after deployment, DB timeout errors appeared in checkout immediately after the latest deploy. Investigate the incident and identify the likely root cause.
symptoms: DB timeout errors appeared in checkout
ground_truth_root_cause: DB connection pool exhaustion caused by a reduction in max_connections during deployment

configuration_changes.summary: max_connections lowered from 200 to 80 and idle_timeout increased

expected_evidence: Deployment metadata for checkout-api shows max_connections lowered from 200 to 80 and idle_timeout increased
Logs are dominated by DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
Metrics show a sustained abnormal increase in db_connection_usage
Service runbook for checkout-api recommends checking the same dependency path

title: Checkout-Api incident after SEV-1 deployment
description: The checkout-api began to show checkout requests timing out, inventory calls slowed immediately after the latest deploy. Investigate the incident and identify the likely root cause.
ground_truth_root_cause: Redis timeout cascade caused by stale connection pool settings after rollout

configuration_changes.summary: Redis client retries disabled and socket timeout increased

expected_evidence: Deployment metadata for checkout-api shows Redis client retries disabled and socket timeout increased
Logs are dominated by REDIS_TIMEOUT
Metrics show a sustained abnormal increase in latency_p99
Service runbook for checkout-api recommends checking the same dependency path

description: The inventory-api began to show cache hit rate collapsed, inventory queries slowed immediately after the latest deploy. Investigate the incident and identify the likely root cause.
